tooling: WHMCS-style portal at portal.orangevps.com with login, registration and a knowledgebase; the vendor page says OS instal plus additional IPv4 at USD 2/month each; no API was stated on the pages read
chaining: USD 1.96 a month for a 1 GB box with 2 TB is the cheapest US presence after NATVPS, and the 0.1 Gbps port on the Kansas City row makes it a control-plane box: a scheduler, a DNS primary, a monitoring probe. It is not a transfer host and not a crawler.
